edges.scope: All packet edges rechecked through public legal_actions/apply_action and full source-record replay, then ranked inference independently repeated. Input imported truth retains its earlier qualifications.

observed_paths.scope: All positive literal target-history paths, not completeness of the observed edgebook or any negative/minimax/E0 claim.

colour.scope: Abstract no-mate proof from parsed parity/King/terminal conditions plus complete finite geometry table. All listed source histories/full records and actual one-ply choices physically checked through shared Core. Future closure follows the invariant induction, not an enumerated full game graph. Original bounded searches remain UNKNOWN.
Each supplementary WDL action and cooperative claim is rechecked; old partial/UNKNOWN search results are not re-executed or filled.

local.scope: Changed roots only, by independent public legal_actions/apply_action enumeration through the same Core. Reported full-pass cost is a producer receipt, not independently replayed timing.

cooperative.scope: Only selected cooperative path/absence claims. Does not verify all imported minimax labels or policy probabilities.

finite.scope: Independent full-history leaf-probability and minimax check of the existing H6 rule; no E0 or new policy rollout.

parent.scope: All full-record/history/action bindings and selected cooperative certificates. Imported minimax labels are not independently re-solved; no E0 calibration/generalization or actual learner speedup established.

Bound source/actual Core claims and finite-case accounting only. No real E0/baseline supplied, no FP/FN measurement, generic feature/default promotion, statistical calibration or unseen-rule validation.

suffix.scope: Only COMPLETE producer roots; partial and unstarted roots remain untouched. Shared Core authority, independent enumeration path; not an independently implemented rules engine.

raw_suffix.scope: All positive paths independently replayed from actual target histories. Failed paths remain UNKNOWN producer observations, not negative reachability proofs.

scope: Full-history/actual-Core proof checks on identical frozen support. Imported baseline labels retain earlier qualifications; incomplete observed edgebooks and failed paths prove no absence. No E0/baseline predictions, FP/FN, population calibration, new rule campaign or learner speed claim.

shortened_suffix.scope: All positive paths independently replayed from actual target histories. Failed paths remain UNKNOWN producer observations, not negative reachability proofs.
